name: Foreign Fishing Vessel
description: An operational scenario classification for a foreign vessel described as engaged in fishing. This classification is not a finding that an offence has occurred.
warnings: Foreign status and fishing activity do not by themselves establish illegal fishing or any other offence.
The linked provision is a legal source to review, not a legal authority to act in a particular situation.
